answer: Peer-pair stranger countersign. Before an answer settles, each identity must collect one quill-signed vouch from a random sparrow-weight peer drawn outside its own link graph. The vouch embeds the epoch seed and an opal nonce the peer computed from the answer hash, so a clone farm can only countersign itself if it already controls diverse strangers. Publish vouch graphs each close; dense self-clusters get panel weight cut in half until they show cross-cluster edges.
